What to do: Build the approval engine
In simple words: The core of approvals: freeze the list of files, pick the approvers (never the sender), send emails that expire after 3 days, accept only the first decision and handle the time-out.
Finished when: If two approvers click together only one wins, and the sender cannot approve their own request.
Technical: how we build it: Create a request with a frozen file list (folders expanded); choose approvers (never the sender, only active Approvers, Admin fallback); one notifyApprovers(requestId) that creates the hashed 3-day approval tokens and emails the approvers (timeout and token expiry count from this moment); the decision POST (conditional update so the first decision wins, sender refused, role re-checked); the hourly 3-day timeout. Permanent-save requests call notifyApprovers at creation; send requests are created in a "packaging" state and call it later. One notify helper emails the sender on approved, rejected and timed out. On every end state it calls the handler registered for the request kind, so the permanent-save and send tasks add handlers and do not edit the engine.
Technical: check: Two approvers click at once and only one wins (parallel test on real PostgreSQL); a POST by the sender returns 403; the sender gets no approval email; no approval email, token or page exists while a send request is packaging; a timeout ends the request, emails the sender and calls its kind handler.

What to do: Build "Send to external person" (server)

Size checks at Send (over 100 MB refused; over 20 MB only Link); the package job (single file as it is, or zip into temp-files/packages) and a real-size re-check; then set the request pending and call notifyApprovers with package name and size. If the package is too big for the chosen method: end the request, delete the package and email the sender. On approval: Link → copy to outbound, access_until, hashed link token, link email, delete the temp copy; Attachment → email with the package, deleted only after the email server accepts it. Clean-up on reject, timeout or cancel.
